title: Smartphone-integrated sensing platform based on a “one-stone-three-birds” strategy for real-time quantitative detection of Ag(I) ions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17393-17400
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02021F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lihua Zhang, Jiang Li, Tengyan Gao, Wei Liu, Zirui Zhang, Zezhong Chen, Feng Feng
A smartphone-integrated platform using a “one-stone-three-birds” strategy enables quantitative Ag(I) detection in environmental water. Its ultra-simple design overcomes on-site detection hurdles, offering a novel Ag(I) monitoring alternative.
